## Key Information

- **Standard Tracer Size**: 1/2 inch (15 mm) diameter pipes
- **Installation**: Steam tracers must be stripped to the lower part of process pipes as heat moves upward
- **Applicable Conditions**: Normal insulated pipes in normal surrounding conditions
- **Conversion**: 1 inch = 25.4 mm

## Example
For a 4 inch transport system carrying vegetable oil with solidification temperature at 40°C (104°F), **two 1/2 inch steam tracing pipes** are appropriate.
